summary: Validated Memory Phase 2 (STRICT per-org isolation). Backend pytest: 13/13 passed including the critical chat-loop isolation test (fact seeded in Org A appears in Org A's agent reply but does NOT leak into Org B's agent reply). Frontend MemoryPanel UI on /app/account verified end-to-end: org picker renders, untagged migration banner appears, add-toggle text reflects active org name, switching org reloads list scope, manual add succeeds in selected org.

issues: Grammar bug: heading reads '1 memory need an organization' when count is 1 — should be 'needs'. File: /app/frontend/src/components/MemoryPanel.js line ~276. Pluralization only handled for 'memor(y|ies)', not 'need(s)'.
Pre-existing: 401 console errors during initial unauthenticated GETs on auth page (cosmetic, unrelated to memory).

action_items: Minor: fix 'memory need' → 'memory needs' singular grammar in MemoryPanel.js UntaggedMigrationBanner header.
critical_code_review_comments: memory.py — index migration is clean: drops legacy user_scope_content_unique_idx and creates org-aware user_scope_org_content_unique_idx idempotently on every boot. Same fact in two orgs no longer collides.
memory.py — list_memories uses a sentinel (_UNTAGGED) to distinguish 'any org' from 'untagged only'. Important defense against accidental cross-org leaks; well-commented.

memory.py — build_memory_context_block returns empty string when org_id is falsy. This is the single backstop that prevents legacy untagged memories from being injected into ANY agent reply. Verified: chat-loop test confirms Org B does not see fintech fact.

memory_routes.py — _user_must_belong_to_org enforces ObjectId validation + db.org_members membership check on every POST and on PATCH when org_id is being changed. Correct 403 (not 404) semantics for non-member orgs.
memory_routes.py — GET with no org_id correctly defaults to untagged-only (never leaks other orgs).
server.py L3275-3284 — passes team['org_id'] into build_memory_context_block and wraps in try/except so memory failure cannot break chat. Good.
MemoryPanel.js — OrgPicker uses localStorage to remember the last-selected org per user; sensible UX. Pickoff defaults to first org if remembered one is no longer in the user's org list.
MemoryPanel.js — AddMemoryForm gates submit on both content AND orgId, so no chance of POSTing org_id='' from the form. UntaggedRow refuses assign if no target chosen.
Minor cosmetic: grammar bug in untagged banner — '1 memory need an organization' should be 'needs'. Single string fix.

The critical chat-loop test (Org A reply mentions fintech, Org B reply does NOT) PASSES — strict isolation is real, not just an API contract.
